retrievalProfile.description: A centered square portrait framed by a dark, blue-lined diamond grid background with arched and script typography.
triggerTerms: arched slab serif with drop shadow

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark charcoal background featuring a thin blue diagonal crosshatch pattern, centered with a square photographic portrait. The layout is framed by bold, arched slab-serif text at the top and bottom, with a delicate script line connecting the upper text to the image.
coreVisualRelationships: Arched top text follows the curve of the central subject's head
Thin blue grid lines contrast against the heavy dark background
Script text acts as a visual bridge between the bold header and the image
Symmetrical vertical alignment of all typographic and photographic elements
coreInvariants: Thin blue diagonal crosshatch grid pattern on a dark base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered square portrait occupying approximately 40% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central photographic portrait of the man in nautical attire.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow starting from the arched header, through the script, into the portrait, and ending at the bottom footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark space around the central image, filled with the geometric grid pattern.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Light blue for grid lines and text shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for primary text and portrait highlights
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation background with high-value white text for maximum legibility.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and elegant monoline script
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick vertical strokes and blocky serifs
Script text features exaggerated loops and swashes on terminals
Arched text maintains consistent letter spacing along the curve
characterSpecificRedesigns: Slab serifs are slightly rounded at the corners
Script 'S' and 'f' have extended decorative curls

composition.rotation: arched at top, straight at bottom

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of heavy, geometric slab serifs with fluid, decorative script.
graphicDevices: Small nautical ship icon at the bottom center

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure and blocky terminals.
Captures the looped, decorative nature of the connecting text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark charcoal square canvas with a thin, light blue diagonal diamond grid pattern. Place a square photographic portrait of a man in a sailor hat and blazer in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add arched white slab-serif text with a light blue drop shadow at the top. Add a line of white script text below it. Add straight white slab-serif text with a light blue drop shadow at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Does the background have a blue diamond grid?
Is there a light blue drop shadow on the slab-serif text?
Is the portrait centered and square?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the grid lines are perfectly diagonal and consistent.
Ensure the arched text is centered relative to the portrait.
Verify the drop shadow color matches the grid line color.
Confirm the script text is legible against the dark background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Dark grid background + centered square photo + arched slab-serif header + script connector.
